name: Dvenadcataja zhizn'
source:
They say that if you want something immensely, it will definitely come true. Those who wish to realize their dream receive a supernatural ability — the way to its fulfillment! A high school student, Tyler discovers such a power in himself: the talent to control the flame, which henceforth serves as his second heart. Meanwhile, it turns out that his friend Jean also has an unusual gift: he can command time. But who are these mysterious ghosts that roam around? Are these persecutions somehow connected with the boys' magic?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2082210/]Steam[/url]]
